reason: Chutney is an impulsive daily grocery requirement, not something I want to order on a website and wait 3 days for courier delivery. If I need dip for parathas, I just grab a bottle from the kirana downstairs or order on Zepto in 10 minutes.
objection: Waiting multiple days for courier delivery makes zero sense for everyday table condiments.
would_change_my_mind: Immediate 10-minute delivery on Blinkit or Zepto, or stock in local retail grocery stores.
